<subject>Damage to Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd Equipment on Rail Carrier</subject>
<body>
Waiting on response from your people about :  
Meeting with adjuster about going after Kalgoorlie Transport Services.
Hiring engineering expert to hopefully refute underwriter's surveyor's opinion.

Have written letter to rail operator to extend time for filing suit (this protects the subrogation interests of the underwriter).

Seeking clarification as to policy requirement of filing "suit" against underwriter within one year of occurrence.  Broker feels that this is not necessary as the claim was filed and is currently pending, but will get written clarification from underwriter/adjuster.

Michael Boyer to contact Perth attorney who represents Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd underwriter about joining in their suit against rail operator.

If any one above has anything else to add, or corrections to what I have listed above, please add at this time so we are all on the same wave length.
</body>
<quoted>
 
</quoted>
